triggering_failure.message: scenario 'AMBIGUOUS' state chain broke: expected previous_state='TERMINAL', got 'ARMED'

root_cause: Independent both-sides-swept diagnostic events reused the literal scenario_id AMBIGUOUS, so the event-ledger validator joined unrelated terminal chains. The Nautilus run and strategy decision process had already completed; the failure occurred while validating the merged research event ledger.

transformation.purpose: Give each diagnostic-only ambiguous sweep a deterministic causal identity.
transformation.allowed_diff: One local identifier assignment and replacement of the literal diagnostic scenario_id argument.
transformation.workflow_enforcement: Verify all 17 original blobs before patching; reject any diff outside logic.py; require the exact one-block diff; require the same patched logic SHA in all intervals.

non_effects: No liquidity pool, auction state, FAR/AAC confirmation, market leadership or arbitration rule changed.
No candidate plan, direction, entry, stop, target, expiry or cost assumption changed.
No risk quantity, 3% loss budget, global slot, order type, fill model or NautilusTrader accounting changed.
No market outcome was used to define the transformation.
claim_treatment: The exact origin blobs remain recorded in every source_lock. The patched runtime SHA is separately required to be identical across H01-H16 and any subsequent continuous frozen evaluation.
